about: ComfyUI changes ComfyQ is waiting for. Maintenance > Install updates > Check fetches ComfyUI's releases and says, for each entry, whether a stable release holds its commit yet, and what to do then (server/maintenance/updater.js, comfyWaiting). Remove an entry once it is done.
